title: IRC technology news from the first half of 2026
excerpt: Technical summaries of developments in IRC software and protocol specifications during the first half of 2026.
content_html:
In the previous news article I expressed my disappointment about the flood of vibe-coded IRC projects. A couple of things happened since then. The IRCv3 Working Group started adding AI markers (robot icons) to software listed in the support tables on ircv3.net when it is known to be developed with substantial AI assistance. The members of Codeberg e. V. voted 358 to 144 to prohibit vibe-coded projects from the free Codeberg code hosting service. All of this is very helpful for evaluating new software projects.

Below you will find an entry for a new mobile app called Mensajitos, which in a refreshing turn of events is coded by traditional brain-hand coordination and has a clear and sensible AI policy. It truly is nectar for the weary soul to see such projects still being created.

Protocol specifications

The working group published a spec round-up in February, highlighting the ratified reply client tag and Websockets as well as updates to react client tag, Metadata and client-batch. Since the round-up post, the group ratified Account Extended Ban, no-implicit-names extension, channel-context client tag and introduced a draft oper-tag extension. Updates to existing specs and drafts included chathistory-context and chathistory-end tags and an ACCOUNTREQUIRED ISUPPORT token alongside several improvements to the account-registration draft spec.

Mobile clients

goguma - for mobile Linux, iOS and Android

Support was added for network icons and avatar metadata, sharing videos from the phone’s media library, unreactions, redacting reactions, chathistory-end tag, CHATHISTORY TARGETS pagination and ACCOUNTREQUIRED ISUPPORT token.

IRCCloud - connect to any IRC server out there, and even Slack workspaces

The Android app received UI updates for improved compatibility with newer Android versions and the handling of reply tag in the iOS app was made more robust.

Mensajitos - client for Android and iOS

This is a new client that was made public in June. It aims to feel like a real mobile chat app rather than a terminal client pushed inside a phone screen. It makes use of React Native.

Weechat-Android - WeeChat relay client for Android

Error messages are now shown in snackbars (messages at the bottom of the screen) and the copy dialog was improved.

WeechatRN - WeeChat relay client for mobile using WebSockets

A button for scrolling to unread messages was added and it is now possible to configure the relay path.

Web clients

Convos - Go in the backend and Svelte in the frontend

The backend was ported from Perl to Go. The plugin system was dropped as it was tightly coupled to Perl, the CMS was removed, OIDC login support was added for single sign on, Web Push is now supported for notifications on mobile clients, channel mode handling was improved, support was added for server-time, multi-prefix, userhost-in-names, extended-join, the message tags msgid, account and reply and /ignore and /unignore commands were added for filtering messages from nicks locally in the client.

gamja – a bare-bones web client

The user experience of file uploads was improved and a router was added, allowing to restore the focused buffer on page refresh per a URL scheme.

irc-hybrid-client - single user hybrid client using JavaScript frontend and Node.js/Express backend

A custom background colour can be specified for each IRC channel and an allow list for websocket Origin was implemented.

KiwiIRC – uses static files and supports theming and plugins (JavaScript)

The dark theme was improved and language detection was made more robust.

The Lounge - modern web client utilising Node.js

A /cleartopic command was added, msgid tags are now handled, actions like /me now receive STATUSMSG indications, accessibility was improved and the mobile viewport now behaves well when the virtual keyboard appears.

Desktop clients

bIRC - a native client for macOS

This is a new app, which already supports all IRCv3 features, including the ones in draft state. It also works with bouncers, supports DCC file transfers and is scriptable with JavaScript.

ERC - an Emacs IRC client

A match API was added for reacting to the content and other data of messages, desktop notifications became more configurable and a settings module was added for applying options granularly.

geoIRC - a client for Commodore GEOS in 6502 assembly

To use this, you need GEOS running on a Commodore 64 with a 1541 Ultimate II+ cartridge or an Ultimate 64. On YouTube there is a general presentation and a technical deep-dive about the client.

Halloy – cross-platform client written in Rust

Additions include a /connect command to temporarily connect to a server, support for transparent background, ability to add multiple keybinds for a single shortcut, support for emoji reactions with IRCv3 react, ability to insert emojis and commands by clicking their picker entries, multi-line send support, typing indicator support, file uploading using soju.im/FILEHOST, channel-context support, /massmessage command to send Ergo/Solanum mass-messages, ability to copy messages via context menu, persistent message drafts, support for displaying SVGs, a nick and channel completion picker, support for reply, draft/message-redaction, metadata, WebSockets and bot mode IRCv3 features.

New settings allow the user to hide server icons in sidemenu, set the default reason for QUIT and PART, tweak the font size of messages that contain only emojis, disable confirmation of delivery for sent messages, specify queries added to the sidebar after connecting to a server, configure font line height, control when automated away messages are shown and how they look like and hide unread indicators for queries among other things.

Irken – a small, modular client written in Tcl/Tk

The reconnection plugin was made more robust.

MERK – cross-platform, multiple-document interface client

Channel topics can optionally be displayed in tooltips for channel entries in the windowbar, Markdown can be used to format input text, support was added for ASCIImoji shortcodes, IRC colours can be injected into input, Wayland session on Linux is now supported, an optional “tip of the day” dialog displaying at startup was added, new channel chats can optionally trigger a systray flash notification, Flatpak was added as an installation method on Linux, new plugin examples were added, SASL authentication is now supported, IRCv3 capability negotiation was improved, a log viewer was added with search functionality, scripts can be defined to execute upon connection to a server or a specific channel, plugins can request IRCv3 extensions from the server allowing them to handle extensions that MERK doesn’t support natively, custom word highlighting can be defined with the new /highlight command, the bot status of users is now displayed in user lists and away messages can optionally be shown as tooltips in the nickname display.

mIRC – 95 ‘til infinity (Windows-only)

Editboxes in custom dialogs support grayed out optional text, dark mode support was improved and the installer no longer requires admin access.

Pidgin - a multi-network/protocol chat application

The first alpha releases of Pidgin 3.0 were made, 2.95.0 and 2.96.0. A new fully bindable AccountSettings API was added, the account editor was revamped and avatar support was added.

Polari - GNOME’s client

Thumbnails now look better on HiDPI displays.

RudeChat - Python client designed to be fast, portable, and fun

Nickname colouring was improved.

Terminal clients

clown - a client written in Rust

More basic features were added to this new client such as tab completion, message logs and support for multiple server connections.

senpai - TUI client made for bouncers

An Alt+Delete shortcut was added for deleting the next word from cursor, spell checking is now possible, the /upload command called without arguments now uploads the clipboard content, support was added for draft/chathistory-end tag and Windows binaries are now available.

SMDT - Sega Megadrive/Genesis terminal emulator, telnet and IRC client

Messages can optionally have timestamp prefixes.

Swirc - lightweight ICB and IRC client

A /userhost command was added alongside handling of RPL_USERHOST events and a /log command was added for log file management.

tiny – client written in Rust

A configuration option was added for disabling server autoconnects.

WeeChat - the extensible chat client

The /eval command now has an option -e for evaluating all commands before executing them and the typing indicator text can be customised.

Bouncers

They stay online, so you don’t have to!

KiwiBNC – for one person or 10,000 people (Node.js)

Message retention and cleanup logic were implemented for the SQLite message store.

soju – multi-user bouncer

Support was added for unencrypted HTTP/2 and PROXY protocol PP2_SUBTYPE_SSL_CLIENT_CERT, a soju.im/client-cert IRC extension was added for managing client certificates, draft/unreact, draft/extended-isupport, CHATHISTORY AROUND and draft/ACCOUNTREQUIRED are now supported and a Quassel PostgreSQL importer tool was added.

ZNC - an advanced bouncer

The experience with Goguma mobile client connections was improved, standard hardening response headers are now emitted in the web admin and relevant API endpoints and SSL is now enabled by default when connecting to servers.

Daemons

Ergo - combining the features of an ircd, a services framework, and a bouncer

PostgreSQL and SQLite can be used as history backends, HTTP API endpoints were added for listing channels, viewing or modifying the DEFCON level, for changing account passwords and for running whois, support was added for draft/ACCOUNTREQUIRED, draft/chathistory-end and draft/AUTHTOKEN, the /v1/check_auth API endpoint now supports certificate fingerprint authentication, a configurable notice can now be sent to clients upon connection to help detect open proxies, websocket authentication can make use of cookies and auth-script and ip-check-script can be run over Unix domain socket.

InspIRCd - stable, high-performance and modular

Support was added for IRCv3 features ACCOUNTEXTBAN, no-implicit-names, UTF8ONLY, many improvements were made to extended bans, including the ability to share bans between channels, TLS fingerprints can now be forwarded from HAProxy, support was added for local-only X-lines, the swhois and sacommands modules were rewritten, maximum targets can now be configured per command, an interactive configure script was added and WHO responses now include account tags.

InspIRCd would like your help in testing development releases of v5.0.0.

Ircd-hybrid - a lightweight, high-performance daemon

The LIST command now implements the standard ELIST creation-time filters correctly and many smaller improvements were made.

Solanum - an IRCd for unified networks

Support was added for BATCH, no-implicit-names, channel-context, reply, labeled-response, the documentation for hooks was overhauled, a quarantine module was added and the spamfilter now has a bypass capability.

UnrealIRCd - the most widely deployed IRCd

Settings were added for controlling the use of SETIDENT and SETNAME, the module manager now allows 3rd party modules to specify external libraries and build flags, more security features from the OS and hardware level will be used whenever available, support was added for draft/multiline, the conditional features of configuration were expanded, many new crule functions were added for controlling security groups, match items and spamfilter rules, the connection throttling works better against IPv6 clone attacks and server bans and spamfilters have more statistics.

Bots

This and the next section has been curated with programming language diversity in mind.

Calculon – library for writing bots and a collection of plugins (OCaml)

The codebase was migrated to use the irky library with its Eio backend.

Eggdrop - the oldest bot still in active development (C/Tcl)

The web UI received further development, support was added for extended bans and the bot now handles arbitrary channel modes without freaking out.

gluon_bot - a general purpose bot (Rust)

This bot got its start in 2023 and by now has features like events, games, plugins, quotes, RSS/Atom feeds, time zones and weather.

Limnoria - robust, full-featured, and user/programmer-friendly bot (Python)

Windows support was added or improved for various plugins.

PBot – a pragmatic bot (Perl)

The search in the Unicode character property applet and in the Factoids plugin was improved and a new random-quote applet with local database was added.

Sopel - lightweight, easy-to-use utility bot (Python)

Plugin callables were reworked, allowing greater flexibility for plugin authors.

Libraries, frameworks and utilities

Ibis - a GObject based library (C)

A Client::stopped signal was added and constants were added for standard replies and metadata.

irc by hyperimpose - a client library for Erlang

The development of this Erlang library started in 2024. It supports IRCv3 capabilities and extended-join.

IRC::Client - Extendable Internet Relay Chat client (Raku)

Nickname handling was improved.

irc-framework – for bots and full clients (Node.js)

Support was added for standard-replies, handling of ZNC connections was improved and Unix sockets can now be used instead of a hostname and port combination.

irc-go - libraries to help with IRC development (Go)

Capability negotiation was made more robust.

ircv3-filehost-server - HTTP server for use with servers that lack native support for FILEHOST (Go)

This is a new utility that was started in April this year. It allows server operators to offer file hosting regardless of the IRCv3 daemon they use. The FILEHOST spec has not been ratified and is undergoing some changes.

irky - simple direct-style client (OCaml)

This is a fork of irc-client, now offering optional SSL/TLS support and direct-style IO backends (Unix, Eio).

NetIRC - simple Portable client library targeting .NETStandard 2.0 and .NET Framework 4.6.1 (C#)

The API was fully documented.

redis-irc-bot - minimal IRC bot framework (Bash)

Support was added for account-tag.

superseriousstats - a fast and efficient program to create statistics out of various types of IRC chat logs (PHP)

A colour scheme switcher was added to the CSS styles.

Bridges

Biboumi - XMPP to IRC gateway

An option was added for deleting older messages from the database and the implementation of draft/multiline was polished.

Dis4IRC - a modern Discord <-> IRC bridge

Bridging is now supported for slash commands and components.

irgramd - connect from an IRC client to Telegram as a regular user

File downloading was made more robust.

Reliable Discord-client IRC Daemon (rdircd) - personal discord-client to irc-server translation daemon

An option was added for replacing Unicode emoji with ASCII.

teleirc – bridge to Telegram

An installation script to install as a systemd unit was added.

whatsircd - a messaging bridge between IRC and WhatsApp

This bridge saw the light of day in August 2025. It supports reactions and replies and supports CardDAV for keeping contacts up to date.

Services

Taking care of user accounts and channels among other things.

Anope – highly modular set of services

Hostmasks can be either cleaned up when adding them to an access list or rejected, the output of nickserv/list shows more relevant information, the cs_set_misc and ns_set_misc modules for associating information with a channel or a nickname now support validation of user-specified data, the information defined via ns_set_misc can be shown in WHOIS output of authenticated users on InspIRCd and UnrealIRCd, regex_posix and regex_tre modules are available on Windows and examples were added to several BotServ commands.

Atheme - for large networks with high scalability requirements

Documentation was added for the JSONRPC module and a NEVEROP flag was added for groups to prevent others from adding the group to channel access lists.

在上一篇新闻文章中，我表达了对大量 vivi 编码 IRC 项目的失望。 从那时起发生了几件事。 IRCv3 工作组开始向 ircv3.net 支持表中列出的软件添加 AI 标记（机器人图标），而已知该软件是在大量 AI 协助下开发的。 Codeberg e 的成员。 五、 以 358 票对 144 票投票禁止免费 Codeberg 代码托管服务中的 vivi 编码项目。 所有这些对于评估新的软件项目都非常有帮助。

下面您将找到一个名为 Mensajitos 的新移动应用程序的条目，该应用程序以传统的脑手协调方式进行编码，并具有清晰合理的人工智能策略，令人耳目一新。 看到这样的项目仍在创建，对于疲惫的灵魂来说确实是甘露。

协议规范

该工作组在 2 月份发布了规范综述，重点介绍了已批准的回复客户端标签和 Websockets 以及响应客户端标签、元数据和客户端批次的更新。 自综述发布以来，该组织批准了帐户扩展禁令、无隐式名称扩展、通道上下文客户端标签，并引入了操作标签扩展草案。 对现有规范和草案的更新包括 chathistory-context 和 chathistory-end 标签以及 ACCOUNTREQUIRED ISUPPORT 令牌以及对帐户注册草案规范的多项改进。

移动客户端

goguma - 适用于移动 Linux、iOS 和 Android

添加了对网络图标和头像元数据、共享手机媒体库中的视频、无反应、编辑反应、聊天记录结束标签、CHATHISTORY TARGETS 分页和 ACCOUNTREQUIRED ISUPPORT 令牌的支持。

IRCCloud - 连接到任何 IRC 服务器，甚至 Slack 工作区

Android 应用程序收到了 UI 更新，以提高与新 Android 版本的兼容性，并且 iOS 应用程序中回复标签的处理变得更加强大。

Mensajitos - 适用于 Android 和 iOS 的客户端

这是六月份公开的新客户。 它的目标是感觉像一个真正的移动聊天应用程序，而不是推入手机屏幕内的终端客户端。 它利用了 React Native。

Weechat-Android - 适用于 Android 的 WeeChat 中继客户端

错误消息现在显示在小吃栏中（屏幕底部的消息），并且复制对话框得到了改进。

WeechatRN - 使用 WebSockets 的移动 WeeChat 中继客户端

添加了用于滚动到未读消息的按钮，现在可以配置中继路径。

网络客户端

Convos - 进入后端，Svelte 进入前端

后端从 Perl 移植到 Go。 插件系统因与 Perl 紧密耦合而被删除，CMS 被删除，添加了单点登录的 OIDC 登录支持，现在支持移动客户端上的 Web 推送通知，改进了通道模式处理，添加了对服务器时间、多前缀、用户主机名、扩展连接的支持，添加了消息标签 msgid、帐户和回复以及 /ignore 和 /unignore 命令，用于在客户端本地过滤来自昵称的消息。

gamja – 一个简单的网络客户端

改进了文件上传的用户体验，并添加了路由器，允许根据 URL 方案恢复页面刷新时的聚焦缓冲区。

irc-hybrid-client - 使用 JavaScript 前端和 Node.js/Express 后端的单用户混合客户端

可以为每个 IRC 通道指定自定义背景颜色，并实现了 websocket Origin 的允许列表。

KiwiIRC – 使用静态文件并支持主题和插件 (JavaScript)

黑暗主题得到了改进，语言检测变得更加强大。

The Lounge - 使用 Node.js 的现代 Web 客户端

添加了 /cleartopic 命令，现在处理 msgid 标签，像 /me 这样的操作现在接收 STATUSMSG 指示，可访问性得到改进，并且当虚拟键盘出现时，移动视口现在表现良好。

桌面客户端

bIRC - macOS 的本机客户端

这是一个新的应用程序，它已经支持所有 IRCv3 功能，包括草稿状态的功能。 它还可以与保镖配合使用，支持 DCC 文件传输，并且可以使用 JavaScript 编写脚本。

ERC - Emacs IRC 客户端

添加了匹配 API 以对消息的内容和其他数据做出反应，桌面通知变得更加可配置，并添加了设置模块以精细地应用选项。

geoIRC - 6502 装配中 Commodore GEOS 的客户端

要使用此功能，您需要在带有 1541 Ultimate II+ 盒或 Ultimate 64 的 Commodore 64 上运行 GEOS。 YouTube 上有关于客户的一般性演示和技术深入探讨。

Halloy – 用 Rust 编写的跨平台客户端

新增内容包括临时连接到服务器的 /connect 命令、支持透明背景、为单个快捷方式添加多个按键绑定的能力、支持 IRCv3 React 的表情符号反应、通过单击选择器条目插入表情符号和命令的能力、多行发送支持、键入指示器支持、使用 soju.im/FILEHOST 上传文件、通道上下文支持、发送 Ergo/Solanum 群发消息的 /massmessage 命令、通过复制消息的能力上下文菜单、持久消息草稿、支持显示 SVG、昵称和频道完成选择器、支持回复、草稿/消息编辑、元数据、WebSocket 和机器人模式 IRCv3 功能。

新设置允许用户隐藏侧菜单中的服务器图标，设置退出和部分的默认原因，调整仅包含表情符号的消息的字体大小，禁用已发送消息的传送确认，指定连接到服务器后添加到侧边栏的查询，配置字体行高度，控制自动离开消息的显示时间及其外观，以及隐藏查询的未读指示符等。

Irken – 用 Tcl/Tk 编写的小型模块化客户端

重新连接插件变得更加强大。

MERK – 跨平台、多文档界面客户端

频道主题可以选择显示在窗口栏中频道条目的工具提示中，Markdown 可用于格式化输入文本，添加了对 ASCIImoji 短代码的支持，可以将 IRC 颜色注入到输入中，现在支持 Linux 上的 Wayland 会话，添加了启动时显示的可选“每日提示”对话框，新频道聊天可以选择触发系统托盘闪烁通知，添加了 Flatpak 作为 Linux 上的安装方法，添加了新的插件示例，现在支持 SASL 身份验证，IRCv3功能协商得到改进，日志查看器添加了搜索功能，脚本可以定义为在连接到服务器或特定通道时执行，插件可以从服务器请求 IRCv3 扩展，从而允许它们处理 MERK 本身不支持的扩展，可以使用新的 /highlight 命令定义自定义单词突出显示，用户的机器人状态现在显示在用户列表中，并且可以选择在昵称显示中将离开消息显示为工具提示。

mIRC – 95 直到无穷大（仅限 Windows）

自定义对话框中的编辑框支持灰显的可选文本，改进了暗模式支持，并且安装程序不再需要管理员访问权限。

Pidgin - 多网络/协议聊天应用程序

Pidgin 3.0 的第一个 alpha 版本已发布：2.95.0 和 2.96.0。 添加了新的完全可绑定的 AccountSettings API，改进了帐户编辑器并添加了头像支持。

Polari - GNOME 的客户端

缩略图现在在 HiDPI 显示器上看起来更好。

RudeChat - 旨在快速、便携且有趣的 Python 客户端

昵称着色得到改进。

终端客户

clown - 用 Rust 编写的客户端

这个新客户端添加了更多基本功能，例如选项卡完成、消息日志和对多个服务器连接的支持。

senpai - 专为保镖打造的 TUI 客户端

添加了 Alt+Delete 快捷方式，用于从光标中删除下一个单词，现在可以进行拼写检查，不带参数调用的 /upload 命令现在可以上传剪贴板内容，添加了对草稿/chathistory-end 标记的支持，并且现在可以使用 Windows 二进制文件。

SMDT - Sega Megadrive/Genesis 终端仿真器、telnet 和 IRC 客户端

消息可以选择具有时间戳前缀。

Swirc - 轻量级 ICB 和 IRC 客户端

在处理 RPL_USERHOST 事件的同时添加了 /userhost 命令，并添加了 /log 命令用于日志文件管理。

tiny – 用 Rust 编写的客户端

添加了用于禁用服务器自动连接的配置选项。

WeeChat - 可扩展的聊天客户端

/eval 命令现在有一个选项 -e，用于在执行所有命令之前对其进行评估，并且可以自定义键入指示符文本。

保镖

他们保持在线状态，所以您不必这样做！

KiwiBNC – 适用于一个人或 10,000 人 (Node.js)

消息保留和清理逻辑是为 SQLite 消息存储实现的。

soju – 多用户保镖

添加了对未加密 HTTP/2 和 PROXY 协议 PP2_SUBTYPE_SSL_CLIENT_CERT 的支持，添加了 soju.im/client-cert IRC 扩展来管理客户端证书，现在支持草稿/unreact、草稿/扩展-isupport、CHATHISTORY AROUND 和草稿/ACCOUNTREQUIRED，并添加了 Quassel PostgreSQL 导入器工具。

ZNC - 高级保镖

Goguma 移动客户端连接的体验得到了改进，标准强化响应标头现在在 Web 管理和相关 API 端点中发出，并且现在在连接到服务器时默认启用 SSL。

守护进程

Ergo - 结合了 ircd、服务框架和保镖的功能

PostgreSQL 和 SQLite 可用作历史后端，添加了 HTTP API 端点用于列出频道、查看或修改 DEFCON 级别、更改帐户密码和运行 whois，添加了对草稿/ACCOUNTREQUIRED、草稿/chathistory-end 和草稿/AUTHTOKEN 的支持，/v1/check_auth API 端点现在支持证书指纹身份验证，现在可以在连接时向客户端发送可配置的通知以帮助检测开放代理，Websocket 身份验证可以使使用 cookies 以及 auth-script 和 ip-check-script 可以在 Unix 域套接字上运行。

InspIRCd - 稳定、高性能和模块化

添加了对 IRCv3 功能 ACCOUNTEXTBAN、无隐式名称、UTF8ONLY 的支持，对扩展禁令进行了许多改进，包括在通道之间共享禁令的能力，现在可以从 HAProxy 转发 TLS 指纹，添加了对仅本地 X 线的支持，重写了 swhois 和 sacommands 模块，现在可以为每个命令配置最大目标，添加了交互式配置脚本，WHO 响应现在包括帐户标签。

InspIRCd 希望您帮助测试 v5.0.0 的开发版本。

Ircd-hybrid - 一个轻量级、高性能的守护进程

LIST 命令现在可以正确实现标准 ELIST 创建时过滤器，并进行了许多较小的改进。

Solanum - 统一网络的 IRCd

添加了对 BATCH、无隐式名称、通道上下文、回复、标记响应的支持，对钩子文档进行了彻底修改，添加了隔离模块，并且垃圾邮件过滤器现在具有绕过功能。

UnrealIRCd - 部署最广泛的 IRCd

添加了用于控制 SETIDENT 和 SETNAME 的使用的设置，模块管理器现在允许第 3 方模块指定外部库和构建标志，将在可用时使用操作系统和硬件级别的更多安全功能，添加了对草稿/多行的支持，扩展了配置的条件功能，添加了许多新的规则功能来控制安全组、匹配项和垃圾邮件过滤器规则，连接限制可以更好地抵御 IPv6 克隆攻击，并且服务器禁令和垃圾邮件过滤器具有更多统计信息。

Bots

本节和下一节的设计考虑到了编程语言的多样性。

Calculon – 用于编写机器人的库和插件集合 (OCaml)

代码库已迁移为使用 irky 库及其 Eio 后端。

Eggdrop - 仍在积极开发中的最古老的机器人 (C/Tcl)

Web UI 得到了进一步的开发，添加了对扩展禁令的支持，并且机器人现在可以处理任意通道模式而不会惊慌。

gluon_bot - 通用机器人（Rust）

该机器人于 2023 年启动，目前拥有活动、游戏、插件、报价、RSS/Atom 源、时区和天气等功能。

Limnoria - 强大、功能齐全且用户/程序员友好的机器人 (Python)

添加或改进了对各种插件的 Windows 支持。

PBot – 一个实用的机器人 (Perl)

Unicode 字符属性小程序和 Factoids 插件中的搜索得到了改进，并添加了带有本地数据库的新随机引用小程序。

Sopel - 轻量级、易于使用的实用机器人 (Python)

插件可调用对象经过重新设计，为插件作者提供了更大的灵活性。

库、框架和实用程序

Ibis - 基于 GObject 的库 (C)

添加了 Client::stopped 信号，并为标准回复和元数据添加了常量。

irc by hyperimpose - Erlang 的客户端库

这个 Erlang 库的开发始于 2024 年。 它支持 IRCv3 功能和扩展连接。

IRC::Client - 可扩展的互联网中继聊天客户端 (Raku)

昵称处理得到改进。

irc-framework – 适用于机器人和完整客户端 (Node.js)

添加了对标准回复的支持，改进了 ZNC 连接的处理，现在可以使用 Unix 套接字代替主机名和端口组合。

irc-go - 帮助 IRC 开发的库 (Go)

能力谈判更加有力。

ircv3-filehost-server - HTTP 服务器，用于缺乏 FILEHOST 本机支持的服务器（Go）

这是今年四月启动的一项新实用程序。 它允许服务器运营商提供文件托管，无论他们使用什么 IRCv3 守护程序。 FILEHOST 规范尚未获得批准，并且正在进行一些更改。

irky - 简单的直接式客户端 (OCaml)

这是 irc-client 的一个分支，现在提供可选的 SSL/TLS 支持和直接式 IO 后端（Unix、Eio）。

NetIRC - 面向 .NETStandard 2.0 和 .NET Framework 4.6.1 (C#) 的简单便携式客户端库

API 已完整记录。

redis-irc-bot - 最小的 IRC 机器人框架 (Bash)

添加了对帐户标签的支持。

superseriousstats - 一个快速高效的程序，用于根据各种类型的 IRC 聊天日志创建统计信息 (PHP)

CSS 样式中添加了配色方案切换器。

桥梁

Biboumi - XMPP 到 IRC 网关

添加了用于从数据库中删除旧消息的选项，并且草稿/多行的实现得到了完善。

Dis4IRC - 现代 Discord <-> IRC 桥

斜杠命令和组件现在支持桥接。

irgramd - 作为普通用户从 IRC 客户端连接到 Telegram

文件下载变得更加强大。

可靠的 Discord 客户端 IRC 守护进程 (rdircd) - 个人 Discord 客户端到 irc 服务器的翻译守护进程

添加了用 ASCII 替换 Unicode 表情符号的选项。

teleirc – 通往 Telegram 的桥梁

添加了作为 systemd 单元安装的安装脚本。

Whatsircd - IRC 和 WhatsApp 之间的消息传递桥梁

这座桥于 2025 年 8 月竣工。 它支持反应和回复，并支持 CardDAV 以保持联系人最新。

服务

照顾用户帐户和渠道等。

Anope – 高度模块化的服务集

主机掩码可以在将其添加到访问列表时清除或拒绝，nickserv/list 的输出显示更多相关信息，用于将信息与频道或昵称关联的 cs_set_misc 和 ns_set_misc 模块现在支持用户指定数据的验证，通过 ns_set_misc 定义的信息可以显示在 InspIRCd 和 UnrealIRCd、regex_posix 上经过身份验证的用户的 WHOIS 输出中regex_tre 模块在 Windows 上可用，并且示例已添加到多个 BotServ 命令中。

Atheme - 适用于具有高可扩展性要求的大型网络

为 JSONRPC 模块添加了文档，并为组添加了 NEVEROP 标志，以防止其他人将组添加到通道访问列表。
